name: University of Lausanne
summary: Lausanne's general university, sharing a lakeside campus with EPFL; bachelor's degrees are taught in French, with a French exam at B1.

ib.text: 32/42; three HL and three SL across six general subjects, maths or a science at HL. Psychology, ESS, Global Politics, Visual Arts and more don't count (2026/27 list). UNIL's French exam at B1 unless exempt.

dates.label: Complete application due if you need no visa (same date every year)
Complete application due if you need a Swiss study visa (same date every year)

notes: Applications for autumn 2027 bachelor's are already open, and there is no spring-semester entry to a bachelor's.
Upload your IB Diploma as soon as you have it, and in any case before classes start in week 38.
Pharmacy is taught only in the first year at Lausanne; you must then transfer to the University of Geneva.
